Small fix release.

## What's fixed

- The status pill now appears over fullscreen apps such as VS Code. Before,
  it stayed hidden while a fullscreen app was in front.

## Known limitations

Same as v0.1.0. The build is still not signed with an Apple Developer ID, so
macOS blocks the first launch. Allow it in System Settings → Privacy &
Security → **Open Anyway**, or run
`xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Yaptic.app`.

## Verify your download

```bash
shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt
gh attestation verify Yaptic_0.1.1_aarch64.dmg --repo iniandrew/yaptic
```
